verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents official SDKs across Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, and Java, plus a Wasm client, Postgres-compatible endpoint, and official CLI/drivers, giving AI-native developers multiple sanctioned ways to build integrations. This is reinforced by MCP server SDK-like tooling for agentic access and dbt adapter integration. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking or hands-on developer reports specifically validating SDK completeness/quality across all listed languages.
